question: Should this exact head remain blocked until live proof covers its doctor config mutation and retained-store discovery, or should those later commits be split from the already proven gateway fix?
rationale: Tests and source inspection support the implementation, but repository policy requires real behavior proof for an external PR’s exact changed behavior, and the current evidence predates the compatibility-sensitive expansion.

options.title: Split the doctor expansion
